services.name: Shark Fishing
services.desc: We’re heading way out there. Tight Lines invites you to join our daily offshore fishing trips departing from the historic Charleston Harbor. Depending on the season, we target world-class sport fish including dolphin (mahi-mahi), tuna, wahoo, sailfish, and marlin. Whether you’re a seasoned angler chasing a personal best or a beginner looking for your first big-game experience, our offshore charters promise a memorable day in the “blue water.” We use top-tier tackle and proven techniques to put you in the best position to land a legendary catch. Immerse yourself in the bountiful waters of the Carolina coast and experience an exciting adventure that only the deep Atlantic can provide. Tight

blurb: Tight Line Charters offers all-inclusive inshore, nearshore, and offshore fishing excursions, shark fishing, coastal Lowcountry sightseeing tours, harbor cruises, and more. Guests fish for species like Redfish, Spotted Seatrout, Black Drum, Flounder, Sheepshead, and Black Seabass. The business is owned and operated by Captain Jesse Riddle, who provides expert local knowledge and top-tier gear.

quotes.author: Anna Costley
quotes.text: We had a blast going on a morning charter with Capt Jesse!!! Beautiful scenery and so much fun catching multiple species of fish, Capt Jesse really cares about having his clients catch quality fish to ensure a memorable experience. He even made sure we went on a day with good weather and that we went at a good time of day. Nicest and most welcoming captain and we loved talking with him. Thanks so much Capt Jesse we will definitely be back! -Aaron & Anna

quotes.author: Catherine Lopez
quotes.text: Captain Jesse was great. He was easy to communicate with. He was very accommodating when my 5 year old was feeling sea sick. He worked hard to find us other spots where we could fish with calmer waters that still provided a great experience. He knows a lot about the area and fishing in general. We had a great time and highly recommend him!

quotes.author: James Elrod
quotes.text: Captain Jesse is the best, great time fishing, caught plenty of fish. We plan on doing this every year and will definitely be calling Jesse when we do. Thanks for a great fishing trip Captain!

quotes.author: Ron Woosley
quotes.text: Captain Jesse has a ton of knowledge about local fish. He will go above and beyond to help you catch fish. I would book a trip with him again.
